help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.undoLimits: u undoes your own changes from this session, up to 50: adding, titles, dates, completing, moving, tags, descriptions and deleting. Undoing an add moves the task to the Trash. Undo doesn’t check for newer changes by others, and undoing a completion doesn’t remove the next task a repeating task created.
help.offline: The terminal app works online only: without a connection the status says offline, and changes fail with r to retry.

key.collapse: Collapse the group or task, or go to the parent
key.expand: Expand the group or task, or go to the first subtask
key.edit: Edit the title (Enter or Esc saves)
key.date: Date: a phrase like “fri 14:00”, or none
key.nextGroup: Move the task to the next group
key.prevGroup: Move the task to the previous group
key.retry: Retry a failed change, or refresh
key.scrollDown: Page down (scrolls the details when open)
key.close: Close the details, the search or a notice

web.complete: On the web: {web} (x selects rows there)
web.description: On the web: {web} focuses the description in the pane
web.retry: Not on the web, which retries by itself and works offline
web.quit: On the web, q is quick add
